user.title: Maximum Fuel Prices GOV.PL
user.description: Add the integration that downloads maximum retail fuel prices published by the Polish Ministry of Energy on gov.pl. Data is checked every 30 minutes by default.

reconfigure.title: Source and refresh configuration
reconfigure.description: Change how often the integration checks gov.pl for new publications. The integration will reload after the change.

data_description.update_interval_minutes: Choose the automatic data refresh interval.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This integration can only be configured once.

init.title: Maximum Fuel Prices GOV.PL configuration
init.description: Choose a configuration section. The administrator adds phones here, while users can later control notification enablement, delivery mode, time and fuel selection from dashboard entities.

menu_option_descriptions.phones: Add, remove and configure phones. Each phone receives its own switch, delivery-mode select, time entity and fuel select for the dashboard.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_content: Optionally customize the notification title or message.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_filters: Send only on price changes and set a minimum difference.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics: Check source status, history and notification targets, and run manual actions.
menu_option_descriptions.save: Save all changes and reload the integration.

notification_content.title: Notification content
notification_content.description: Fuel selection is configured separately for each phone. Empty template fields use the default content. Templates can use `today_date`, `tomorrow_date`, `published`, `pb95`, `pb98` and `on`. Each fuel exposes `today`, `tomorrow`, `today_text`, `tomorrow_text`, `change` and `difference_grosz`.

data_description.notification_custom_title: Supports Home Assistant templates. Leave empty to use the default title.
data_description.notification_custom_message: Supports Home Assistant templates. Leave empty to use the default message with prices and changes.

notification_filters.title: Price change filters
notification_filters.description: The global change filter can additionally limit scheduled and publication messages. The "after publication only when price changes" phone mode always requires a price change and uses the same minimum threshold.

data.notification_only_on_change: Send only when the price changes

data_description.notification_only_on_change: Applies to scheduled and normal publication modes. The change-only publication mode always filters by price change.
data_description.notification_min_change_grosz: A value of 0 means any change greater than 0gr. The same threshold is used by the change-only publication mode.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Configured phones: {count}. Each phone has its own delivery mode, notification time, fuel selection and enable switch.

menu_option_descriptions.phone_list: Edit the list of phones available to users.
menu_option_descriptions.choose_phone: Choose one phone and open its configuration.
menu_option_descriptions.init: Return to the main configuration menu.

phone_list.title: Phone list
phone_list.description: Select phones registered by the Home Assistant Companion app. After saving, each phone receives its own dashboard entities, including delivery mode.

data_description.notification_services: The administrator decides which phones are available in the integration. Users can later control their phone settings from a dashboard.

choose_phone.title: Choose phone
choose_phone.description: Choose the phone you want to configure.

phone_menu.title: Phone
phone_menu.description: Phone: **{device}**. Home Assistant target: `{target}`. Notifications: {enabled}. Mode: {mode}. Time: {time}. Fuels: {fuels}. Last action: {status}

menu_option_descriptions.phone_settings: Change the name, notification enablement, delivery mode, time and fuels for this phone.
menu_option_descriptions.phone_test: Immediately send a short test notification only to this phone.
menu_option_descriptions.phone_send_now: Immediately send this phone a message in the same format as the daily notification.
menu_option_descriptions.choose_phone: Go directly to another phone configuration.

phone_settings.title: Phone settings
phone_settings.description: Phone: **{device}**. Home Assistant target: `{target}`. Enablement, delivery mode, time and fuel settings are also available as dashboard entities.

data_description.device_name: Enter a custom name or keep the default name.
data_description.device_enabled: When disabled, the phone remains configured but receives no automatic messages.
data_description.device_notification_time: Used by the scheduled mode. If tomorrow prices are not published at that time, the integration waits and sends after publication is detected.
data_description.device_notification_fuels: Choose PB95, PB98, diesel, any pair, or all three fuels.
data_description.device_notification_mode: Scheduled waits for the configured time and then for publication if needed. Publication modes send immediately when a new GOV.PL publication is detected. The change-only publication mode sends only when at least one selected fuel changes by the configured threshold.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and actions
diagnostics.description: Tomorrow price: **{tomorrow_status}**. Last fetch: `{fetched_at}`. Parsed publications: **{parsed_periods}**. Stored history days: **{history_days}**. Last error: **{last_error}**. Missing notification targets: **{missing_targets}**. Last action: **{action_status}**.

menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics_refresh: Immediately check gov.pl and refresh entities.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics_send_all: Send the current daily message to all enabled phones using each phone's individual fuel selection.
menu_option_descriptions.init: Return to the main configuration menu.

parser_error.title: Fuel prices cannot be parsed from gov.pl
parser_error.description: The integration downloaded gov.pl but could not parse fuel price publications. The page layout may have changed. Last error: `{error}`. Check for an integration update or report the problem in the repository.

notification_target_missing.title: Notification phone is unavailable
notification_target_missing.description: Configured phone **{name}** uses target `{target}`, which Home Assistant does not currently provide. Open the integration configuration and select the current phone or disable automatic delivery for this entry.
